#Policewoman.Face.lookateachother
#Policeman.Face.lookateachother
Policeman: Come on! Stop wasting your time and confess!
???: B-But I didn’t do it! Why are you doing this?!
Policewoman: Didn’t you ever hear about quotas? You just got unlucky.
Policeman: Listen, man. You just got the short end of the stick. It happens. You can be a bitch about it and have another arm broken or just do what we want you to do.
#Policeman.Face.angry
#Policewoman.Face.angry
???: {{punch}}Hey! You! Help me! They are going to torture me!
W-What? What am I supposed to help you?! It’s impossible!
Policewoman: If you know what’s best for you, you will keep your cellphone in your pocket and move along, citizen.
You: S-Sure…
